## Biography

The largest globular cluster in the Milky Way. Ten million stars packed into a sphere a hundred and fifty light years across, so dense that the night sky of any planet inside it would have no darkness — only degrees of brightness.

The Fimbulthul takes its name from the stellar stream associated with Omega Centauri: the Fimbulthul Stream, a river of stars torn from the cluster by galactic tides over billions of years. CMDR Drew Wagar's expedition to the Zurara in the Formidine Rift passed through this region, establishing connections between the cluster, the Rift, and the darker history of Generation Ships. The Children of Raxxla's Operation Caldwell 1 also operated here, seeking answers in the spaces between the stars.

Omega Centauri is old — older than the galactic disk itself, possibly the remnant core of a dwarf galaxy consumed by the Milky Way. It has watched civilisations rise and fall across the galaxy. It does not judge. It simply continues shining, indifferent to the explorers who pass through its outer halo and wonder what it has seen.
